scope: Static Master .35 aux event trace. Hardware and shared Ghidra project were not accessed.

findings.claim: Four functions write the detection byte and dispatch module0x27/event0x7d.
Consumer0x082456a0 forwards detection into requested audio-path state and route operations.
A successful F323 read that parses aszero blocks event7d. A failed read setsminus1 and does not block it.
Routine0x082454bc writes0x0420f43d. Ordinary detection passes its persistence argument aszero, so this path does not write NVKEY.
Initialization creates named line_in and line_out objects at0x042479b8 and0x042479fc.
The three wrappers queue operations1/2/4. They do not establish successful backend completion.
